func schedule(_ items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    Task(priority: .utility) { await work(item) }
    Task.detached(priority: .utility) { await work(item) }
    Task(name: "background", priority: .utility, executorPreference: executor) { await work(item) }
    Task.detached(name: "background", priority: .utility, executorPreference: executor) {
      await work(item)
    }
    Task(priority: .utility, operation: { await work(item) })
    Task.detached(priority: .utility, operation: { await work(item) })
  }
}

func repeated(_ items: [Int], _ groups: [[Int]]) async {
  for item in items {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    await Task(priority: .utility) { await work(item) }.value
  }
  for group in groups {
    Task(priority: .utility) {
      for item in group {
        // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
        await work(item)
      }
    }
    Task.detached(
      priority: .utility,
      operation: {
        for item in group {
          // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
          await work(item)
        }
      })
  }
  for item in items {
    Task(priority: .utility) { await work(item) }
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    await save(item)
  }
  for item in items {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    Task(priority: await choosePriority(item)) { await work(item) }
  }
}
